segments.text: Ask anyone over thirty and they will say it like a confession... the years are getting faster. Fourteen hundred years ago, that exact feeling was named... as a sign of the end.
segments._shot: city timelapse, streaking lights, day to night

segments.text: This is the sign... of the shrinking time.
segments.title: THE SHRINKING TIME
segments._shot: slow spinning star trails on deep black

segments.text: The Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, gave his companions a list of what the last stretch of history would feel like. Not just wars and wonders... but how ordinary days would feel. And the first feeling on one famous list... is time itself.
segments._shot: sand pouring steadily off a dune crest

segments.text: Time will pass rapidly... he said... good deeds will decrease... miserliness will be thrown into hearts... and afflictions will appear. It is recorded in Sahih al-Bukhari... and it reads like a diagnosis of a century he never saw.
segments._shot: fast clouds racing over a static mountain

segments.text: Another narration paints the acceleration in detail. The Hour will not be established until time is constricted... the year like a month... the month like a week... the week like a day... the day like an hour... and the hour like the flare of a fire. A flare... the moment you see it, it is gone.
segments._shot: a match-strike flare blooming and dying in darkness

segments.text: The scholars offered several readings... blessing draining out of time... life actually compressing... or hearts too distracted to feel the hours pass. The narration does not choose for us. It only promises that when the end approaches... time will feel like it is running away. Does it?
segments._shot: fast-forward crowds blurring through a station-free plaza, abstract

segments.text: You cannot slow the river. But anyone who has stood in prayer at dawn knows some minutes still run deep... remembrance slows the heart, even when nothing slows the clock. Slow minutes... are still for sale. Barely anyone is buying.
segments._shot: still lake at dawn, absolute calm
